root_cause.summary: hibiki_engine_preview.exe terminated with STATUS_STACK_OVERFLOW during the SceneApply control transaction that followed a PrepareIr command; the client observed the control pipe die mid-round-trip and EasyControlViewModel.SendCommandAsync returned false through its generic exception path.
root_cause.debugger_evidence: cdb second-chance capture: stack overflow at hibiki_engine_preview+0x28e07 with a single ~626 KB frame at +0x2907f (main-loop/wmain frame) on the default 1 MB MSVC x64 stack; scene round-trip spanned ~830-1260 ms before death.
contributing_factors: AudioEngineModel::prepare_ir allocated a fixed ~256 KB IrConvolverV1 candidate as a stack local
the engine preview executable used the default 1 MB stack reserve while its main thread hosts several fixed-capacity control structures worth hundreds of KB per frame
PrepareIr is acknowledged at enqueue time, so the heavy IR transaction and the immediately following SceneApply transaction run back-to-back inside one drain, peaking combined stack use
stack headroom depends on build layout, which explains the originally reported intermittent 1-in-3 to burst failures

fixes.change: reserve an 8 MB stack for hibiki_engine_preview via target_link_options(/STACK:8388608) under MSVC, mirroring the existing hibiki_contract_tests harness reserve
heap-allocate the IrConvolverV1 candidate in AudioEngineModel::prepare_ir with fail-closed allocation handling instead of a ~256 KB stack local

reproduction.harness: untracked .local/diagnostics/scene-ack/SceneAckDiag.exe replicating the smoke sequence (connect, -18 dB volume, One-Tap game scene, LinearPhase IR prepare, SelectSceneAsync(movie)) with LastCommandFailureDetail reporting

pre_fix.note: remaining rounds could not connect because the engine process had already died from earlier crashes

product_observability: EasyControlViewModel.LastCommandFailureDetail now records which SendCommandAsync fail-closed path fired (not-connected-at-entry, not-connected-after-gate, null-command, non-ack-reply, cancelled, exception) so hosts can report ack failure reasons without masking them
limitations: User-space Windows 26200 verification only; no physical audio, loadable driver, WaveRT, HLK or Microsoft signing evidence.
The RT audio thread rules are untouched: all changed code paths are control-plane transactions or link configuration.
Smoke-side StatusText instrumentation in apps/control-model-engine-smoke/Program.cs remains a follow-up child slice blocked by active lane #272 scope ownership.
